_about: One row per persona finding, written at triage. verdict: fixed | refuted (could not reproduce, or the game was right) | design (a call, not a bug; note says whose) | deferred (real, not yet done) | duplicate. Fixed rows before round 51 are NOT here — they are the pinned tests (tests/js/round*.test.js, playtest*.test.js); `node tools/findings-ledger.mjs --stats` merges both views.
